text:
samira-k: Hi CS team  Samira here, first day! Two quick blockers: my HubSpot contact sync shows duplicates and I don't see the latest CS playbook or the call-scoring rubric. Who should I poke?

ben-csops: welcome Samira! @cody-salesops owns the sync mapping, I'll grab playbook access. For duplicates, usually an import header mismatch or a duplicate email property. Share the CSV and I'll take a look.

cody-salesops: hey Samira  happy you're here. send the HubSpot import file or the list name. We have an automatic dedupe rule on Email+Company; sometimes the CSV has extra whitespace. I can run a dry import to show changes first.

samira-k: sending the file now to Drive > CS > Imports > samira-import.csv. Also the Notion link in the onboarding card points to an older playbook version.

docs-bot: Notion access: request created for samira-k. Page: Notion  Customer Success  Playbooks  CS Playbook (v3 draft). Assigned to ellie-onboard.

ellie-onboard: took the Notion request, adding you with view+comment. I'm also going to pin the call-scoring rubric PDF to the Quick Start section. That rubric lives in Drive > CS > Operations > Call Scoring v1.2.

access-bot: Access ticket CS-11011 created (Notion page + Drive collateral). ETA ~45 minutes.

ben-csops: looked at the CSV: emails are fine but Company column contains trailing commas which HubSpot treats as different strings. I ran a quick clean and dedupe preview; it suggests merging 8 contacts. Want me to proceed or run full import?

samira-k: please proceed with the cleaned import, thanks. Also, what's the preferred flow for transferring a lead to Sales from CS?

cody-salesops: we use HubSpot property "Lifecycle Stage" plus a tag "escalate-to-sales" and create a HubSpot task for the AE. Best practice: include 2-line context and a preferred intro time. Example note: "Billing issue resolved? No. Needs AE for contract amendment. Prefers 10am PST call."

ellie-onboard: adding our canned transfer template to Notion > Playbooks > Templates. Transfer template snippet: ```Hi <AE>, transferring <Customer> for contract amendment. Quick context: <one-liner>. Preferred times: <options>.```

samira-k: got it. After the cleaned import I can see contacts consolidated. Thanks! Quick question on Aircall: my softphone rings but I can't record test calls. Is recording toggled per-number?

ben-csops: yes, recordings are controlled at account and number level. I'll check your number mapping. If you need recordings for training, we toggle recording and add the clip to Gong. Note: recordings default to 90-day retention.

access-bot: CS-11011 updated: Notion access granted. Drive files shared.

cody-salesops: pro tip for Gong: search tag:"cs-transfer" and you'll see examples of good handoffs. Also use the Gong note template when transferring so the AE gets context in the recording.

samira-k: where do I find the call-scoring rubric? I couldn't find it in Drive after the share.

ellie-onboard: uploaded the rubric to Drive path: Drive  Sales & CS  Operations  Call Scoring v1.2.pdf and mirrored a copy into Notion Quick Start. Rubric covers: Greeting, Problem Identification, Outcome Clarity, Next Steps, Tone. Each scored 1-5.

ben-csops: small ops note: when tagging dispositions use exact keywords (no spaces) so automations pick them up. e.g. use "escalate_to_sales" not "escalate-to-sales" if you want the auto-assignment rule. We'll standardize in the playbook.

samira-k: odd — my first shadow session is scheduled but the calendar invite shows a different timezone. Where should I update my profile?

ellie-onboard: update your profile timezone in Workday > Profile and in Google Calendar settings. I fixed the existing invite and re-sent it.

cody-salesops: FYI for imports, if you want to preview dedupe rules run: ```hubspot-cli import --dry-run --file=path/to.csv```. Ops will do the heavy lifting for first-week imports.

samira-k: thanks, all done. One last ask: are there short one-pagers for pricing to keep handy on calls? The Notion link was restricted.

ellie-onboard: pricing one-pagers live in Drive > Sales & CS > Collateral > Pricing One-Pagers. I granted view access; you might need to accept the Drive share. For anything restricted, ping legal or me and we'll route it.

ben-csops: import finished: 8 duplicates merged and 25 new contacts added. HubSpot list "CS Onboard - Samira" created.

samira-k: perfect, I can see the list and drive files. Appreciate the quick help! I'll post here if anything else pops up. :smile:
